iWant: to name my Squire and give it a personality in a guided first conversation, and have it keep them
soThat: my Squire feels like mine and stays that way after fresh starts and updates
description: The guided first conversation covers what Squire can do, how approval works, the Squire owner's privacy words, house style, fresh starts and where pages appear; it can pause and resume. Teaching when asked is part of the guided first conversation's criterion; plain words and short answers are reviewed behaviour, not criteria.
title: The first conversation: a Squire with the name and personality its owner gives it

acceptanceCriteria.description: Squire keeps the name and personality the Squire owner gives it, and uses them in its replies.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A Squire owner who has named their Squire and given it a personality
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire starts afresh, and after Squire is updated
acceptanceCriteria.then: The name and personality are unchanged, and Squire's replies use them.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A name or personality Squire cannot keep safely is asked for again and never kept.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A Squire owner naming their Squire who gives a name or personality that is empty or blank, longer than Squire keeps, or holds control characters, new lines, the marks that hold it in what the session loads, a heading or a code fence
acceptanceCriteria.when: Set-up's naming step reads the answer
acceptanceCriteria.then: Set-up asks for that value again, saying why, and never stores it; a value it accepts is stored as given, trimmed.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Squire's guided first conversation gets to know the Squire owner: it keeps a profile, a house style and a learning log in the Squire owner's folder, can pause and pick up later, and teaches when asked.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A new Squire owner starting a signed release of Squire for the first time
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Squire owner walks the guided first conversation, pauses it and picks it up later, and asks Squire to teach them how something works
acceptanceCriteria.then: The conversation picks up where it paused; a profile, a house style and a learning log are kept in the Squire owner's folder; and Squire teaches what was asked in plain words.
